_about: 0.4.0 (6 Nov 2026), the owner: full haptics. modules\controller\docs\HAPTICS.md 10. Trigger effects stands beside Rumble and shows in simple mode only with a pad that has triggers to drive; the rest under Show all settings. Nothing felt yet.

rows.label: Trigger effects
rows.help: Your triggers feel the ship: weight, vibration, a wall when you cannot fire. On Xbox: pulses, by USB or dongle.

rows.label: Trigger strength
rows.help: How strong the trigger effects are, on top of Full or Light. A DualSense Edge needs its trigger stops at Long.

rows.label: Haptics
rows.help: Waveform drives a USB DualSense's grips directly and needs its speaker at four channels in the Sound panel. Automatic: motors for now.

rows.label: Ship and engine
rows.help: The engine, afterburner, cruise charge, tractor, nebulas and asteroids. Zero leaves the ship quiet.

rows.label: Weapons
rows.help: Your guns, missiles, mines and countermeasures. Zero: no grain under your fire.

rows.label: Hits and danger
rows.help: Hits from where they came, missiles, collisions, blasts, radiation, a failing hull.

rows.label: Set pieces
rows.help: Trade lanes, jump gates, jump holes, docking and launching.

rows.label: Prompts
rows.help: The autopilot handing the ship back, and boxes that wait for your answer.

rumble.help: Vibration strength for everything: your ship, weapons, hits and warnings. Zero switches it off.
